# Mateus Bonette

> AI Engineer (Applied AI Engineer) and Software Engineer based in São Paulo, Brazil. Computer Science graduate from UNIFEI and postgraduate student in Applied AI Engineering at UNIPDS. Co-founder and Software & AI Engineer at Junta Já Brasil.

## Summary

Mateus Bonette builds production AI systems and full stack software integrating LLMs, RAG, AI agents, tool calling, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with APIs and relational/vector databases, with emphasis on reliability, deterministic validation, automated testing, observability, and cost control.

## Experience

### Software & AI Engineer (Co-founder) — Junta Já Brasil
- Period: Jun 2026 – Present | Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Remote)
- Co-founder responsible end to end for software and AI engineering of a personal financial management SaaS in production with 100+ users.
- Automated bill and bank statement reading using OCR, Gemini, and Vertex AI: over 1,000 statements processed (average 100+/month) with >90% extraction and categorization accuracy, JSON schema extraction, normalization, deduplication, and validation before saving to PostgreSQL, cutting organization time from hours to under 1 minute.
- Combined deterministic rules with Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) review for edge cases and quality tracking.
- Built Ari, a WhatsApp AI assistant using Tool Calling and real system APIs with Harness Engineering controls to prevent unverified calculations.
- Created Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with ~80 tools for Google Cloud and Cloudflare.
- Implemented LLM observability covering tokens, cost, latency, execution errors, document caching, model fallback, and monthly spending limits.
- Stack: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Celery, Cloud Tasks, PostgreSQL, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Docker, GitHub Actions, Google Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Secret Manager, WhatsApp API, Mercado Pago, Spec-Driven Development (SDD).

### Full Stack Developer | Applied AI, RAG & LLMs — Moontech
- Period: May 2024 – Jun 2026 (2 yrs 2 mos) | Location: Itajubá, MG, Brazil (Remote)
- Built full stack and applied AI solutions for enterprise clients in a software factory environment.
- Led the data platform of an urban mobility multinational for ~1 year, replacing manual spreadsheets with an API-integrated dashboard (Python, Streamlit, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL) used by 20+ people and cutting report generation from 3–4 hours to ~1 minute.
- Integrated a LangChain RAG agent to organize and categorize incoming data and answer natural-language queries.
- Digitized ISO 9001 quality control for a food industry company (React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL) used by 10 staff across tablets and desktops, reducing query time from hours to minutes and passing the ISO 9001 audit. Implemented a RAG agent with tool calling, guardrails, and parameterized PostgreSQL queries for leadership meetings.
- Built RAG pipelines with LangChain, LangGraph, embeddings, chunking, and pgvector integrating OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini, monitored with Langfuse for prompts, tokens, latency, and cost optimization.
- Also built full stack applications with Angular, React, Next.js, GraphQL, Python, FastAPI, Docker, and AWS.
